meta.title: Sensitive content guard
meta.description: Masks secrets, identity data, addresses, medical records, system credentials, local paths, device ids, emails, IPs and private URLs before a request leaves for the gateway, and reads text and QR payloads inside images. Runs on Windows through the built-in OCR engine and elsewhere through Python plus tesseract; without a recognizer it still masks all text and redacts images. Nothing is blocked: a hit only raises the log level. Run node ocr/selfcheck.mjs after moving to another machine. Turn it off by disabling the plugin row.
